aurora_borealis.name: Aurora Borealis
aurora_borealis.summary:
Archmaga and quaesitor, Aurora of Jerbiton, filia Marianne, the oldest quaesitor in the Tribunal and the architect of the Treaty of Baghdad. A daughter of Alpine nobility, she was struck by lightning at eight, which woke her Gift and showed her how she will end: in Final Twilight, from a second strike. Her mater loved the stars; Aurora cared for earthly things and for people, took early to Corpus and studied Mentem deeply, and after her Gauntlet stayed twenty years at her mater's covenant, a favourite of the grogs and covenfolk she helped with her magic.

Then she came to the Levant, founded Domus Pacis in 1169, and, watching Salah al-Din unite the Muslims, saw the danger to the Order: from 1183 she treated in Baghdad with him, the caliph and their mages, and brought the quaesitores of Magvillus a way to end the fighting. When the Treaty was forced through in 1193 she was made a quaesitor, moved to Baghdad to keep the peace, founded the Embassy, and soon became an archmaga. It was she who proposed that only a Guernicus quaesitor may preside at the Tribunal, so that she would never be accused of bias in the chair.

At 102 she looks in her late sixties: slim, with long red hair streaked with grey, in bright, well-cut robes of many colours, still beautiful; many young magi have lost their hearts to her, and she has never let it go further. Age and creeping Twilight are telling on her: a hard Twilight lately damaged her Animal, she feels her hold on the world loosening, and she fears for the Levant if she goes soon, for Spiral could not carry on her diplomacy. She is looking for an answer.

Her one apprentice, Macha, is now a maga in a covenant in Hibernia; she shares her mater's interests, leaning more to Mentem than Corpus.

elaine.summary: Elaine of Jerbiton, filia Hergar, of al-Arama, which hates Esther of Domus Pacis for breaking its hold on the Levant's trade. The book gives no more of her.

barnabas.name: Barnabas
barnabas.summary: Barnabas of Verditius, filius Hildegard, of al-Arama, which hates Esther of Domus Pacis for breaking its hold on the Levant's trade. The book gives no more of him.

thomasin.name: Thomasin
thomasin.summary: Thomasin of Mercere, filius Hengest, of Venti Rosa. An un-Gifted Redcap, usually away with urgent messages.

ibrahim.name: Ibrahim
ibrahim.summary: Ibrahim of Mercere, filius Mahmud, of Venti Rosa. An un-Gifted Redcap, usually away with urgent messages.

simon.name: Simon
simon.summary: Simon of Mercere, filius Dora, of Venti Rosa. The caravan's one Gifted magus, who stays with it, makes magic items for his fellow Redcaps and can set up a working laboratory almost anywhere, using a howdah on a camel for work that must be left to stand. His twin sister Sarah watches over him.

sarah.name: Sarah
sarah.summary: Sarah of Mercere, filia Dora, of Venti Rosa. An un-Gifted Redcap, Simon's twin, who stays with the caravan to look after him, more closely than he needs.

khayzuran.name: Khayzuran
khayzuran.summary: Khayzuran of Mercere, filia Nur al-Din 'Ali, of Venti Rosa. An un-Gifted Redcap, usually away with urgent messages.

ruth.name: Ruth
ruth.summary: Ruth of Bonisagus, filia Orestes, of the Pyramids (I), obsessed like Pariah with the pyramids' secrets, and with him master of the spirits of Giza.

pariah.name: Pariah
pariah.summary: Pariah of Criamon, filius Celeriter, of the Pyramids (I), who with Ruth commands the spirits of Giza and is trying to read the hieroglyphs of the Great Pyramid's burial chamber.

heliobus_magister.name: Heliobus Magister
heliobus_magister.summary: Heliobus Magister of Bonisagus, filius Maximus Cosinus, a respected researcher drawn to the temple of Thoth and Anubis in 1177 to take a dead priest's place, who brought the priesthood into House Ex Miscellanea in 1178. He studies their ceremonies and seems to want nothing more; with the eleven priests he controls twelve votes at Tribunal.

david.name: David
david.summary: David of Tremere, filius Virgil, a young magus and one of the two founders of the True Cross at Damietta.

xydas.name: Xydas
xydas.summary: Xydas of Bonisagus, filius Marcellus, a young magus and one of the two founders of the True Cross at Damietta.
